subject: [PATCH 02/10] mm/madvise: name the shared LRU PMD callback

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Expressed agreement with the renaming, citing that LRU is a reasonable name for this callback and it handles THP PMDs as well.

2026-09-22.patch_summary: This patch renames the shared LRU PMD callback in mm/madvise.c to better reflect its functionality, which handles both THP and PTE ranges.
